UserPromptSubmit._note: main session: a prompt containing plec/nesupravegheat arms autonomous mode (marker per session) and injects its rules; any later prompt without the signal disarms it

PreToolUse._note: while autonomous mode is armed, questions and plan mode are denied with a reason for the model
any Read of a /tool-results/ file is denied for main and sub-agents alike; the rest (image, re-read, whole big file) is main-session only
main only: big whole reads and big heredoc writes into the project, plus the commit gate before git commit
main only: over 20 written lines in Write/Edit belong to scribe/implementer
main session, every tool: context guard scoped to main

implementer*/scripter* sub-agents only, measured on the worker transcript <dir(transcript_path)>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<agent_id>.jsonl: warns once at 150000 tokens of context, denies every tool except Bash at 220000, and nudges once on the 3rd build/test/verifica-* Bash call; per-type thresholds are opt-in via --praguri-tip; triggers logged in /tmp/claude-hooks/context-agent.jsonl

main and every sub-agent: an Edit/Write/MultiEdit that would add a comment block of 2+ lines, a comment line over 160 chars, or over 25% comments in the added lines; sub-agents are denied on block/long line, main and the ratio criterion only get additionalContext; logs to /tmp/claude-hooks/comentarii-<session>.jsonl

main only: if the effective effort differs from the per-session target (or from settings), every tool is denied with an order to ask the user for /effort; ExitPlanMode/EnterPlanMode/AskUserQuestion are always allowed and an unknown effort never denies
